name: density-soak
purpose: iter-466 density lane: the 200% stability soak. LOAD GAME (custom MAIN MENU, PORT FEATURES ON) from a free-roam save seed (-Gates SR_CONTENT_DIR=<copy of a playthrough boss save>), METROPOLIS, then ~11 min of free roam while tools/player/density_soak_play.txt flies low (sr_roll -PlayScript). Gates for the roll: SR_PORT_FEATURES=1 (sr_roll -PortFeatures 1), SR_TRAFFIC_DENSITY=200, SR_POPULATION_DENSITY=200, SR_HIGHFPS_PACE=1. Read the traffic groups with Frida during the soak (docs/MODS.md 7.3).

steps.name: slots-filled
steps.purpose: the LOAD A GAME list (a dwell: the old [PATH_RESOLVE] FillSlotInfo marker cannot fire since iter-464's skip_lr; its stand-in is [APT_REQ] artassets/SaveImages/SaveImage_N, tools/scenarios/natural_load.json)

steps.name: load-lands
steps.purpose: the loaded game's first screen: main_hud (first hour) or ScrMainMenu (past it); not expectFresh - LoadComplete requests it inside the same call (natural_load.json)

steps.name: metropolis
steps.purpose: past the first hour the load lands on the METROPOLIS / FORTRESS carousel: A = METROPOLIS (lift_proof.json)

steps.name: soak
steps.purpose: 10+ minutes of free roam at the roll's density (tools/player/density_soak_play.txt flies low through the streets beside this dwell)
